==About==

A {{i|Connecticut Field}} is the product of a third growth stage, second tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking a Connecticut Field and selecting "Slice" will give you 6x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 15x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Connecticut Field counts as {{i|Any Large Pumpkin}}. A Connecticut Field can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
